What is SAP Engagement Cloud?
SAP Engagement Cloud is a solution that connects enterprise data and AI to securely orchestrate real-time, personalized interactions across the entire business.

SAP Engagement Cloud Solution Video

Power enterprise-wide performance with:
Trusted SAP data that fuels AI segments, triggers, and journeys.

AI Assistants that drive richer personalization, efficiency, and business growth.  

Activated operational data (such as inventory or order status) to drive engagement.  

API-first architecture and built-in security, governance, and brand knowledge. 

SAP Emarsys is now SAP Engagement Cloud
Learn how SAP is making engagement a core enterprise-wide capability and connecting customer interactions more deeply to how businesses run. 

Read the announcement
Key benefits
Activate data for real-time engagement
Turn operational and customer data into confident, real-time interactions that directly influence demand, revenue, and retention.

Personalize every interaction with AI
Equip marketers with agentic AI that executes personalized messages and relevant actions—so they can improve conversion, efficiency, and experiences.

Connect experiences across the business
Orchestrate marketing, sales, service, and commerce interactions using shared context and embedded AI capabilities, so every experience is relevant and connected.

Scale operations with enterprise flexibility
Accelerate AI adoption across brands, regions, and business areas with a secure, cloud-native, and API-first foundation without compromising compliance or brand consistency.

Key features
Several screenshots showing SAP Engagement Cloud

Show more
Comprehensive omnichannel engagement
Scale personalization with a centralized decision engine and reusable tokens.

Orchestrate campaigns across web, email, SMS, mobile apps, ads, and more. 

Enable rapid content activation with low- and no-code tools governed by enterprise controls.

AI-powered engagements and insights
Joule’s agentic AI surfaces insights, completes tasks, and connects processes.

Advanced business context fuels smarter targeting, timing, and personalization.  

AI-powered content generation and reporting accelerates content creation and performance analysis.

Seamless engagement across SAP Business Suite
Integrate natively with SAP S/4HANA, SAP Analytics Cloud, SAP Business Technology Platform, and SAP Customer Data Platform. 

Apply turnkey integrations and use cases across SAP Sales Cloud, SAP Service Cloud, and SAP Commerce Cloud solutions. 

Unify data models via SAP Business Data Cloud for consistency, governance, and scale.

Extensible, enterprise-grade engagement
Support complex global operations across brands, regions, and subsidiaries.

API-first architecture aligns to SAP’s open data model for streamlined integration.

Support both B2B and B2C data models and use cases.
